levels.title: The Archive
levels.story: Phase 2. A new location. The Archive — a vast underground library of secrets. But the messages are no longer from a friend alone. Someone else is transmitting...
levels.death_message: Archive A is a dead end with automated sentinels. They find you.
levels.success_message: Archive B holds the records you need. The truth begins to unfold.
levels.hint1: Caesar cipher shifts each letter by a fixed number. The shift is -3.
levels.hint2: The first letter after decoding is R.

levels.title: The File Room
levels.story: A coded door. The combination is hidden in an emoji message. But wait — this message came from your future self? The timestamp says tomorrow...
levels.death_message: Destroying the cabinet triggers an alarm. Security swarms the room.
levels.success_message: Inside: your personnel file. They've been watching you for years. The truth is worse than you imagined.
levels.hint1: Each emoji represents a letter. Look at the cipher label for the key.

levels.title: The Terminal
levels.story: A computer terminal. You need to enter a command. A Caesar-shifted message is carved into the desk — probably by someone who was here before you...
levels.death_message: Pulling power triggers a data wipe and lockdown. All doors seal.
levels.success_message: You hack in! The facility map downloads. You see the exit route!
levels.hint1: Each letter in the message is shifted forward by 5 in the alphabet. Shift it back.

levels.title: The Traitor
levels.story: A second voice joins the transmission. It sounds helpful. But your gut says something is wrong. The emoji message appears — but whose side is this sender on?
levels.death_message: Staying was a trap. The Overseer locks the room. You are recaptured.
levels.success_message: You ignored the false signal and ran! The Overseer's trap springs empty behind you.
levels.hint1: The message decodes — but remember, this sender is the ENEMY. Do the opposite.
levels.hint2: The message decodes to STAY — but the enemy wants you to stay.
levels.hint3: The enemy said STAY. Do the opposite: RUN.

levels.title: The Server Room
levels.story: Server racks hum in the cold air. You need to find the right server cluster. A number code is spray-painted on the floor...
levels.death_message: BETA cluster contains the AI's core. Accessing it triggers a full lockdown.
levels.success_message: ALPHA contains the employee records. You find the name of your captor.
levels.hint1: Five numbers = five letters. A=1, L=12, P=16, H=8, A=1.

levels.title: The Cipher Wall
levels.story: An entire wall covered in encoded text. One message stands out — carved deeply, urgently. Caesar-shifted, shift of -7...
levels.death_message: The barrier is electrified at the base. Crawling through is fatal.
levels.success_message: You clear the barrier! A previous prisoner left this message to save you.
levels.hint1: Shift each letter back by 7 in the alphabet.

levels.title: The Decoy
levels.story: Two messages arrive simultaneously. One from Helper. One from the Overseer AI. Which do you trust? The Helper's message is in emoji code...
levels.death_message: Right leads into an ambush. The Overseer's trap snaps shut.
levels.success_message: Left! Helper was right. You find a hidden passage behind a bookshelf.

levels.title: The Fuel Cell
levels.story: The backup generator. You need to shut it down to disable the security grid. A number sequence is etched on the fuel cell housing...
levels.death_message: Destroying the generator causes an explosion. The blast is catastrophic.
levels.success_message: Swapping cells triggers a controlled shutdown. Security grid offline!

levels.title: The Courtyard
levels.story: An open courtyard. Exposed. Surveillance cameras everywhere. A Caesar message is scratched into a stone, shift of -2...
levels.death_message: Sprinting triggers motion sensors. Spotlights find you instantly.
levels.success_message: Crawling keeps you below the camera sweep zones. You cross unseen!
levels.hint1: Shift each letter back by 2. E→C, T→R, C→A, N→W, but the word has 5 letters...

levels.title: The Gate
levels.story: The Archive perimeter gate. The final obstacle of Phase 2. Both Helper and your future self send the same emoji message. It must be right...
levels.death_message: Red keycard triggers an explosive failsafe built into the gate.
levels.success_message: The drab gray maintenance card works! The gate swings open. Phase 2 complete!
levels.hint3: The message spells: DRAB (the gray maintenance card color)
